rationale: Raised actuation ceiling 0.70->0.85 and replaced fixed 0.33 feedforward + small +/-0.25 trim with adaptive hold-bias initialized at nominal 0.33 but allowed to learn 0.0-0.85. Increased integral rate 0.006->0.020 and widened integration gate 0.20->0.35 with strict saturation anti-windup. Kp 0.80->0.90. This directly targets halved heater gain: old trim (+0.25 max, 0.70 cap) cannot supply new hold ~0.73, so y stuck ~0.45; new bias learns +0.40 offset while starting at nominal value so nominal behavior is preserved.

extra.machine_card: Adaptive-bias PI for normalized heater: yf low-pass 12s, u=bias+0.9*e, bias dot=0.020*e gated |e|<0.35, bias in [0,0.85], u in [0,0.85], bias init nominal hold 0.33+(target-0.5)/1.1. Nominal hold ~0.33, degraded hold ~0.73.
extra.predicted_behavior: Degraded plant: initial u~0.65-0.71, y climbs from ~0.12 to ~0.35 by ~150s, bias climbs 0.33->0.6, y reaches 0.45 by ~200-250s and 0.5 by ~280-350s then holds with u~0.70-0.78, steady error ->0, in_band after 300s >0.70, MAE ~0.02-0.035, no overrides/hard violations. Nominal plant: same as before, hold ~0.32-0.34, MAE ~0.014-0.018, in_band ~0.70-0.75, max y <0.6, max u <0.65 except initial transient.
extra.diagnosis: Actuator weaker, gain roughly halved, loss/delay/sensor unchanged. E8 u=0 decay 0.351->0.136 over 480s to ambient ~0.135 with 63% time ~150-200s, essentially same as E2 0.534->0.157 to ~0.15, so tau and ambient unchanged - rules out outflow_increased which would decay faster/lower and response_slower which would hold flat.
